definitions.explanation: Leather made from real animal hide, as opposed to synthetic or artificial leather. A standard label found on clothing, shoes, bags, and other leather goods.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧カバン⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{天然皮革|てんねんひかく}⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧です。
examples.english: This bag is made of genuine leather.

examples.japanese: {天然皮革|てんねんひかく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦すれば→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{長持|ながも}ち→長持ち：14474_nagamochi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Natural leather shoes will last a long time if you take care of them.

examples.japanese: {天然皮革|てんねんひかく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{防水|ぼうすい}→防水：06428_bousui⟧⟦スプレー→スプレー：11581_supuree⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: Natural leather is vulnerable to water, so you should use a waterproof spray on rainy days.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧ (natural) and ⟦{皮革|ひかく}→皮革：28433_hikaku⟧ (leather/hide). This is the formal product label term. In casual speech, {本革|ほんかわ} or {本皮|ほんかわ} is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天然皮革|てんねんひかく}⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧: made of natural leather
- {天然皮革|てんねんひかく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧: leather care/maintenance
- {天然皮革|てんねんひかく}⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧: uses natural leather

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {本革|ほんかわ}: genuine leather — casual equivalent, much more common in everyday speech
- ⟦{合成皮革|ごうせいひかく}→合成皮革：23705_gouseihikaku⟧: synthetic leather — the formal opposite
- {合皮|ごうひ}: faux leather — casual abbreviation of ⟦{合成皮革|ごうせいひかく}→合成皮革：23705_gouseihikaku⟧
- ⟦{人工皮革|じんこうひかく}→人工皮革：23381_jinkouhikaku⟧: artificial leather — another alternative term
